sections.title: Contemporary Spain
sections.description: This course presents a variety of approaches to modern and contemporary Spain. In addition to stressing notions of academic writing and formal analysis, students will read a variety of texts taken from literary, historical and journalistic sources, as well as film. This course is offered in the Penn-in-Madrid summer program.
